name: Ketamine
tierNotes: Threshold: slight softness, nothing more (all curves smooth — nothing spikes early).
Light: mild vertical doubling + painting-flattening begins; colors cool.
Common: clear doubling, frame-hold stutter, desaturation toward gray-blue.
Strong: world visibly shrinking inside a dark surround; tunnel forming (late vignette wakes).
Heavy: full k-hole — scene collapses to a small, flat, contrast-crushed painting swimming in a near-black surround; doubling and stutter are extreme.
